acceptanceCriteria: A dogfood change rerun whose citation plan the committed map already carries leaves a compact (non-indent-2) committed map byte-identical and the worktree clean, and dogfood check then passes (a cmd/corvint test that fails before the fix).
A pass that adds a citation still publishes the cited map.
DCW-V0-019 names the rule and its trace row names the test.
body: Observed in the V1-0019 chi smoke-006 run (loop control L3c-reencoded-control): after the bind, the committed .corvint/change.cem.json was rewritten as compact JSON with identical content and committed on top of the bind. The rerun of `corvint dogfood change BASE` then ran the same citation plan again; `cem cite` re-publishes the map in its indent-2 encoding even when every citation is already carried, so the sidecar was left modified. cem-status failed excluded-artifact-mismatch (target-side bytes differ from the verified input), local-outcome failed record-index-failed, and `dogfood check` refused dirty-worktree. The CEM contract fixes strict JSON, not a byte encoding, so a committed map whose content the pass does not change must stay byte-identical. Fix: in the dogfood change cite pass, when a produced pass leaves a map that decodes to the same JSON value as before the pass, restore the pre-pass bytes.
title: Keep a committed CEM map's bytes when a dogfood change rerun cites nothing new
